speaker: Leonard
text: I know, come home for Sanjay's wedding. What are you doing? He's not a lost dog.

speaker: Penny
text: Sheldon! Hey, why don't you just let me find him while you sit there hitting your imaginary brake?

speaker: Leonard
text: The brake might be imaginary, but that stop sign you just ran wasn't. Eyes on the road! Eyes on the road!

speaker: Penny
text: I said I'm busy, but that wasn't good enough for you.

speaker: Leonard
text: You know what? I hope it's one of those home invasion deals and they show me in the head.

speaker: Penny
text: Well, if it's a home invasion, don't tell them I'm on the toilet.

speaker: Leonard
text: It's no one there. You're hearing things, crazy old lady.
